items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Lee used to be around there. He and Edmund Hall also. Oh, yeah. They were there with Cooney Vons.

ctx.x: Remember much about Hattiesburg. Are there bands up there? Would there be any musicians left there from New Orleans maybe that moved up that way and stayed, do you think?

Well, I don't think so. Lee used to be around there. He and Edmund Hall also. Oh, yeah. They were there with Cooney Vons. Lee Collin, he stayed around there. And also Edmund Hall. They had a band there. They'd go about, you know, like Birmingham, Mobile. Yeah. And still living.
Yeah. Did you ever work along the Gulf Coast very much? Biloxi and Mobile?
